cases.name: Tonya Rochelle Huy
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Tonya graduated from high school and attended Nursing School, where she obtained her nursing degree and became a Registered Nurse. Tonya loved her patients. It wasn't a job to her, she was deeply passionate about caring for others, always putting their needs first. 

In her free time, Tonya enjoyed being outdoors, especially if it was at the creek with her daughter, Courtney and her granddaughter, Ellie. Her most important title was "GiGi," as given to her by Ellie, she loved her girls limitlessly. Tonya also enjoyed trips to the beach with family and friends."
